responsibility: Declares and installs the PA-RISC hooks used by the D front end. It exposes the helper functions implemented in pa-d.cc and maps them onto TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO, making the PA backend’s D-specific version tags and target-info handlers available during D compilation.
same_name_distinction: Declaration/registration header for the PA D support: unlike pa-d.cc, it does not compute target info itself, but exposes the two hook functions and binds them to TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO macros.
